test_PromptSampler_build_prompt: test the PromptSampler class by building a prompt with current program code and metrics
build_prompt_with_metrics: build a prompt using PromptSampler with program code, metrics, and previous program history
create_PromptSampler_instance: create a PromptSampler instance from a Config object to generate evolution prompts

review_PromptSampler_test: review the PromptSampler test to verify system and user prompt keys are present
